review_method.geometry: Use actual native dimensions and recorded reference scale. Cross-profile migration reference supplies control structure, not an exact PW state export.
review_method.execution: Static local reads, original-image views and writing this assigned report only. No local/remote programs, SSH, copy, crop, image processing, tests, builds or probes.
review_method.scope: C4 source/binary remain the frozen DC tuple. Changing C5 production is not evidence. The overall capture suite is mechanically incomplete; existing frames alone are reviewed.
